rewards: 2 x 2,500 Experience Lamps (Any skill over level 30).

st.t: Wear your catspeak amulet, have your cat with you and talk to Unferth in north east Burthorpe.
Talk to Hild in the house north east of Unferth.

Wear the catspeak amulet (e), long-press it in your worn equipment and choose Locate. Tap the whiskers until the arrow and eyes glow white, then follow the arrow to Bob the Cat. He's often in Catherby Archery Shop or at the Varrock Anvil.
Talk to Bob the Cat.
Talk to Gertrude west of Varrock.
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle's library.
s: I have a cat related question.

st.t: Use the catspeak amulet (e) again to locate Bob the Cat.
Talk to Bob the Cat again.
Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem.
s: Ask the Sphinx for help for Bob.

st.t: Rake Unferth's patch
Plant 4 potato seeds in Unferth's patch. These can take 15-35 minutes to grow.
Make Unferth's bed.
Use logs on Unferth's fireplace
Use a tinderbox on Unferth's fireplace.
USE a chocolate cake on Unferth's table.
Use a bucket of milk on Unferth's table.
Use some shears on Unferth in north east Burthorpe.
Wait 15-35 minutes for the potatoes to grow. Your cat tells you when they're ready. Then talk to Unferth in north east Burthorpe again.
Talk to the Apothecary in south west Varrock.
s: Talk about A Tail of Two Cats.

st.t: Talk to Unferth whilst wearing the doctor/nurse hat, a desert shirt and a desert robe, and no weapon/shield.
Use the catspeak amulet (e) to locate Bob once more.
Talk to Bob the Cat again.
Talk to Unferth to complete the quest.
